chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn 'Isa, from Yunus, who said:

I asked al-Rida عليه السلام. I said: May I be your ransom, the people raise their hands in the takbir over the deceased in the first takbir, and they do not raise them after that. So should I limit myself to the first takbir as they do, or should I raise my hands in every takbir? He said: Raise your hand in every takbir.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرَةِ الْأُولَى: the first takbir in the funeral prayer
key_terms.التَّكْبِيرِ: the utterance of Allahu Akbar in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam al-Rida عليه السلام, the authoritative source of the ruling in this narration
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom the funeral prayer is performed
key_terms.كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةٍ: every takbir in the sequence of the funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: Should the hands be raised in every takbir of the funeral prayer or only in the first?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling from Imam al-Rida عليه السلام regarding the funeral prayer over the deceased. He instructs that the hands should be raised in every takbir, not only in the first one, establishing the preferred practice in this act of worship.
